title: Personal Loans Credit Policy Schedule: Loan Amounts and Repayment Terms
content:
Every Personal Loans grade sets the range of loan amounts it offers and the repayment terms it allows. Loan amounts are amounts financed, origination fee included.

## Amounts and terms by grade

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest loan amount, USD | 5000 | 3000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 1500 | 1000 |
| Largest loan amount, USD | 50000 | 45000 | 40000 | 30000 | 25000 | 15000 | 10000 |
| Terms offered, months | 24, 36, 48, 60, 72 | 24, 36, 48, 60, 72 | 24, 36, 48, 60 | 24, 36, 48, 60 | 24, 36, 48 | 24, 36 | 24, 36 |
| Smallest amount for a 60-month term, USD | 10000 | 10000 | 12000 | 15000 | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Smallest amount for a 72-month term, USD | 20000 | 25000 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |

## Definitions

- **Smallest loan amount**: smallest loan amount (amount financed) offered in this grade, USD.
- **Largest loan amount**: largest loan amount (amount financed) offered in this grade, USD.
- **Terms offered**: repayment terms offered in this grade, list of months.
- **Smallest amount for a 60-month term**: smallest loan amount eligible for a 60-month term, USD; "not offered" when the grade has no 60-month term.
- **Smallest amount for a 72-month term**: smallest loan amount eligible for a 72-month term, USD; "not offered" when the grade has no 72-month term.

## Points of reading

- Grades E, F and G have no 60-month term; Grades C through G have no 72-month term.
- Hypothetical: in Personal Loan Grade C an amount financed of 11000 USD reaches the smallest amount for a 60-month term only if it is at least 12000 USD, so it does not; an amount of 12000 USD does.
- Hypothetical: in Personal Loan Grade A an amount of 20000 USD meets the 72-month minimum exactly; in Personal Loan Grade B the same amount falls 5000 USD short of it.
